question: Dave is travelling by car at a speed of 90 km/h. Dave started travelling at 10:20 AM and reached the destination at 1:40 PM. Find the distance travelled.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = 90 km/h.

Total time from 10:20 AM to 1:40 PM = 3 hours 20 minutes = 10/3 hours.

Distance = Speed × Time = 90 × (10/3) = 300 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 300 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the car = 90 km/h

Starting time = 10:20 AM

Destination arrival time = 1:40 PM

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time
